question: Can Gaṅgā bring salvation to those fallen in worldly existence?
premises: Some beings are fallen in worldly existence.
Gaṅgā is present as a saving power.
Gaṅgā is described as causing deliverance.
inference: Gaṅgā may act as the deliverer of those fallen in worldly existence.
plain_english: And Gaṅgā may become the savior of those who have fallen in worldly existence.
